name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 1 – Am 34
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 1a. Stresses that the 2026 budget should avoid creating burdens for citizens and must aim to be more efficient, transparent and performance-based, providing concrete reductions in administrative expenditure and granting an efficient and accountable use of taxpayers’ money; underlines also the need to properly evaluate which funds could be better managed at national level in order to ensure full respect for the principle of subsidiarity;
